discTest.q1Description: Select from the adjectives below those that best represent how you perceive yourself in your daily life. There are no right or wrong answers - choose based on who you truly are, not who you would like to be. We recommend selecting between 8 and 25 adjectives that most accurately describe your natural behavior.
discTest.q2Description: Now, select the adjectives that represent how you believe others - colleagues, leaders, or family members - expect you to act or behave. Again, there are no right or wrong answers. This part shows how you adapt your behavior to external expectations. Select between 8 and 25 adjectives that best represent this perception.
